no libraries: No library configured. Add one in Settings.
no book in libraries: No EPUB files found in your libraries.
Tag: A tag added to each book's MOC properties to identify books. Never added to individual notes.
Library_modal_desc: Obsidian scans these folders for EPUB files.
byDrag: Drop an EPUB file onto the vault to import it. The source file is deleted afterwards.
confirm_delete_source_desc: Permanently delete the source file “{{file}}”? This cannot be undone.
Sync_import_concurrency: How many books to import at once. Set to 1 to import one by one.
onExisting: What to do when a book folder already exists.
Save_path: Where imported books are stored, relative to the vault root. Leave empty to store them in the vault root.
Assets_path: The assets folder is generated from this template, relative to the vault root: {{savePath}} is the value of the save path setting, and {{bookName}} is the book name. Leave empty to store them in the book folder's assets.
Hierarchy_depth: Headings at this level or shallower become separate notes, deeper ones merge into their parent. Set to 0 to keep the whole book as a single note.
Moc_fileName: The MOC file name is generated from this template: {{bookName}}, {{author}} and other variables will be replaced with book metadata. Leave empty to use the book name.
noteTemplate: Each note's body is generated from this template: {{content}} will be replaced with the note body, while {{title}}, {{prev}}, {{next}} and other variables provide chapter info. Leave empty to output the plain body.
Auto_open_right_panel: Show the book's MOC in the right panel while reading its notes.
more_log: Write detailed logs to the developer console.
Enable_Read_Progress_Manager: Remember where you left off in each book. “Open a book” resumes from there.
template_var_unknown: Unknown variable {{var}}, it will be output as-is.
template_sample: Here's what the current format looks like:
sample_body: A sample paragraph of the note body, shown to preview the template.
